metadata.purpose: Fixity verification and data integrity documentation

source_file.notes: Original source file with spaces in field names

output_file.notes: Standardized file with underscores in field names, consistent formatting

data_cleaning: Removed escaped outer quotation marks from titles (e.g., """Lella,"" Brittany" → Lella, Brittany)
Trimmed leading/trailing whitespace from all field values
Preserved internal quotation marks and punctuation
Maintained UTF-8 encoding for international characters
Normalized line endings to Unix format (LF)
No modification of substantive content or data values
character_handling: French accents and diacritics: preserved (é, è, ô, etc.)
Chinese characters: preserved (东周, 清, 現代, etc.)
Japanese characters: preserved (元禄, 玉璜, etc.)
Special dashes: preserved (em-dashes, en-dashes as in source)
